zh-Hans.name: 零网络空间 - 私密相册与文件加密
zh-Hans.subtitle: 离线保存照片视频、笔记和录音
zh-Hans.keywords: 隐藏,保险箱,密码锁,本地存储,私密日记,备忘录,证件,相册管理,隐私保护
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 五款应用图标，全新青环视觉，更顺手的录音体验。照片、视频、文件、笔记与录音在设备本地加密保存。VIP 新增四款专属图标，老用户无需重复购买。
zh-Hans.description:
把照片、视频、文件、笔记和录音保存在设备本地，留一处自己的加密空间。

零网络空间无需注册账号。导入、加密和查看个人内容可离线完成，不提供自动云端上传或同步。

保存与浏览
• 导入照片、视频和文件，使用 AES-256-GCM 加密保存
• 滑动浏览照片，按文件名搜索，支持照片多选与批量删除
• 查看文档，播放视频，保存私人笔记
• 录制语音备忘录，导入音频，暂停播放并调整进度

访问保护
• 使用自己设置的密码解锁
• 支持自动锁定与后台隐私遮罩
• 访客密码提供受限访问，隐藏主用户内容
• 可选择计算器登录方式；应用图标与登录方式分别设置

五款图标
默认青环，以及 VIP 专属的纸页、计算器、山石和尺规。可随时免费恢复默认图标。更换图标不会更改应用名称或数据保护方式。

免费与 VIP
免费版可在 75 个媒体及文件项目额度内使用导入与录音保存，支持默认图标。VIP 为一次性购买，解锁无限导入、录音分享与导出、四款专属图标；已有 VIP 用户无需重复购买。可保存的实际数量仍受设备剩余空间限制。

关于数据与网络
个人内容由应用在本地处理和保存。应用不提供自动云同步；当你主动分享或导出时，内容会交给你选择的目标应用或位置。购买与恢复购买使用 Apple 的 StoreKit 服务，需要网络连接。

请妥善保管密码，并在删除应用或更换设备前保存重要内容的副本。

开源项目与支持：https://github.com/materialofair/zeroNet_Space
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
本次更新让界面更统一，录音操作更顺手。

• 新增五款应用图标：默认青环，以及 VIP 专属的纸页、计算器、山石和尺规。老 VIP 用户无需重复购买，恢复默认免费。
• 重新设计图标选择页，五款图标以紧凑列表展示。
• 启动页与登录页统一青环视觉，启动页适配浅色和深色外观。
• 移除录音列表重复的右滑分享，播放期间禁用列表滑动，暂停后当前播放器仍可安心拖动进度。
• 音频加载时显示进度提示，防止重复点击播放。
• 分享准备改用后台解密，支持取消。
• 保存录音失败时明确提示内容保留，并提供重试和丢弃操作。

en-US.name: ZeroNet Space: Photo Vault
en-US.subtitle: Offline files, notes & audio
en-US.promotionalText: A fresh look, 5 app icons and smoother audio controls. Keep personal content encrypted offline. Existing VIP members get 4 alternate icons at no extra cost.
en-US.description:
Keep photos, videos, files, notes and recordings together in an encrypted space on your device.

ZeroNet Space requires no account registration. Import, encrypt and view your personal content offline, without automatic cloud uploads or sync.

STORE AND BROWSE
• Import photos, videos and files with AES-256-GCM encryption
• Swipe through photos, search by file name and batch-delete selected photos
• Preview documents, play videos and write private notes
• Record voice memos, import audio, pause playback and adjust playback position

CONTROL ACCESS
• Unlock with a password you choose
• Use automatic locking and a privacy cover in the app switcher
• Provide limited access with a guest password while keeping owner content hidden
• Choose an optional calculator login interface; app icons and login mode are separate settings

FIVE APP ICONS
Use the default Loop icon or choose Paper, Calculator, Pebble or Ruler with VIP. Restoring the default icon is always free. Changing the icon does not change the app name or data protection.

FREE AND VIP
The free version supports imports and saved recordings within a 75-item media and file allowance, plus the default icon. A one-time VIP purchase unlocks unlimited imports, audio sharing and export, and four alternate icons. Existing VIP members receive the new icons without another purchase. Storage remains limited by available space on your device.

YOUR DATA AND NETWORK ACCESS
The app processes and stores your personal content locally, without automatic cloud sync. When you choose to share or export, content is passed to the app or location you select. Purchases and purchase restoration use Apple's StoreKit service and require a network connection.

Keep your password safe and save a separate copy of important content before deleting the app or changing devices.

Open-source project and support: https://github.com/materialofair/zeroNet_Space
en-US.whatsNew:
A more consistent design and smoother audio controls.

• Choose from 5 app icons: the default Loop, plus Paper, Calculator, Pebble and Ruler with VIP. Existing VIP members get the new icons at no extra cost. Restoring the default is free.
• Browse all five icons in a compact selection list.
• Enjoy a matching launch and login design, with light and dark launch appearances.
• Removed the duplicate swipe-to-share action from audio rows. Swipe actions stay disabled during playback and on the expanded player when paused.
• Added a loading indicator and protection against repeated playback taps.
• Prepare audio shares in the background, with a cancel option.
• If saving a recording fails, see a clear message with retry and discard actions.
